recognize_zh: 這是 blast gate 的 CD15 對 CD10 流式圖：綠色異常芽細胞群 CD15 完全陰性，CD10 大多為陰性至部分弱陽性，呈垂直條狀分布；缺乏 CD15（成熟髓系）與明確 CD10 表現，有助排除粒細胞分化與 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Dot plot: CD15-PB (x-axis) versus CD10-APC700 (y-axis), gated on blasts
Green population shows a vertical smear of CD10 from negative to dim/partial, without a discrete bright CD10+ cluster
Red residual events also CD15-negative to dim and CD10-negative
No mature granulocytic (CD15-bright) contamination within the blast gate
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD15 versus CD10 gated on blasts shows the abnormal population (green) to be CD15-negative with CD10 ranging from negative to dim partial expression, without a discrete CD10-bright cluster. Residual events (red) are also largely negative. Absence of CD15 argues against granulocytic or monocytic maturation, and the lack of bright CD10 argues against B-lymphoblastic or Burkitt leukemia. This pertinent-negative profile is compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm when combined with CD4, CD56 and bright CD123 expression.

ddx.vs: B-ALL usually shows uniform CD10 with CD19/CD22/TdT, rather than a CD10-negative to dim smear without B markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation or monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: These express CD15 on a subset of maturing cells, which is absent in this population.
